title: Caterpillar Q2 2026 — Construction Industries Executive Brief

statements.text: World CI retail growth accelerated by 15 percentage points from Q1 to Q2 2026.
The CI segment profit bridges remain unresolved: the Q2 2026 volume, price-realization and manufacturing-cost drivers were not quantified, so part of each profit change is not assigned to any driver.
The prior-year CI segment profit comparative has not been tested for restatement.
Dealer-inventory dollars are disclosed at Construction Industries scope in some quarters and company-wide in others.
Price realization appears in both the sales bridge and the segment profit bridge and is a single economic item.

Reported CI sales growth was 34.8% in Q2 2026, compared with 38.1% in Q1 2026; in both quarters Caterpillar's disclosed volume, price, currency and inter-segment components match the reported sales change.

We read the change between Q1 and Q2 2026 as consistent with a shift in the composition of growth toward end-user demand: the disclosed CI dealer build fell from $1.5 billion to $400 million while World retail growth rose from 7% to 22%.

Retail growth is reported in price-neutral dollars and only to the whole percent, while reported sales and dealer-inventory dollars are current-price; these figures support a directional reading and do not form an additive bridge.
Reading the order in which management lists volume drivers as a ranking by size is an unsourced assumption, not a disclosed fact, and that evidence still needs review.
